detail.longDescription: I am working on a Rust LKM. My kernel is Rust enabled and the Rust tool-chain is in working order. There are functions and structs from the net framework that I need to make use of in rust/bindings/bindings_generated.rs of the kernel sources on my machine. As I understand it, these were created with bindgen when compiling the kernel and are the Rust-to-C calls. I change directory into rust/kernel and recursively grep for the function or struct, it's not in use anywhere. So my understanding is, these functions are not available in crate kernel. And of course if I look in crate kernel, I do not see them listed. My question is, how can I start making use of these functions or struct's within the rust/bindings/bindings_generated.rs file? I don't see that they are defined in a module, and therefore unable to include that module in my LKM's code. Do I need to create abstractions for these?
